title: Experiment envelope v1 (draft)
description: DRAFT shogiesa-owned provenance object for a possible shogiesa -> quietset -> lineprior -> veridict pipeline. The 2026-10-03 consumer audit found no compatible shared contract: quietset has no run envelope, lineprior stores opaque provenance strings, and veridict validates a separately maintained flat schema. This schema is therefore not canonical and must not be emitted or vendored before consumer agreement. It describes the contents of a future nested `experiment_envelope` object; all fields are optional except `envelope_version`.

envelope_version.description: Version of this shared schema itself, NOT any one repo's own internal data-schema version (see `producer.schema_version` below for that). Bump only when this shared shape changes; a producer's own schema can version independently without touching this.

producer.description: Identifies which repo/stage populated this particular experiment_envelope object. Every producer in the pipeline sets its OWN identity here when it writes its OWN manifest -- this is not an accumulating history of every upstream stage (see docs/design/experiment_envelope.md's 'reconstructing the chain' section for why: chain reconstruction is done by an external tool joining separate manifests via the hash fields below, e.g. matching one stage's `output_dataset_sha256` against the next stage's `input_dataset_sha256`, not by nesting prior stages' envelopes inside this one).

name.description: Which repo produced this envelope, e.g. "shogiesa"/"quietset"/"lineprior"/"veridict".

schema_version.description: That repo's OWN internal data-schema version (for shogiesa: SCHEMA_VERSION). Deliberately namespaced under `producer`, not a bare top-level `schema_version` on this object -- a bare name here would be ambiguous with a producer's own top-level manifest field of the same name once nested (see this schema's own top-level description).

experiment_id.description: Opaque identifier for the overall experiment run, supplied by the orchestrator. Not interpreted by any one repo.

candidate_id.description: Opaque identifier for the candidate engine/model/config under evaluation.

baseline_id.description: Opaque identifier for the baseline being compared against.

lineage_id.description: Opaque identifier grouping a chain of related experiments (e.g. successive iterations of the same candidate).

input_dataset_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex, verifiable with `shasum -a 256`) of the raw bytes of the dataset file this stage CONSUMED as input. Renamed from v0's ambiguous `dataset_sha256` ("consumed or produced" -- pick one, don't leave a reader to guess which). For shogiesa: hash of `label`'s `--input`. Each stage populates its own input_dataset_sha256/output_dataset_sha256 pair; a consumer verifies chain-of-custody by checking that one stage's output_dataset_sha256 matches the next stage's input_dataset_sha256, not by relying on a single shared field meaning different things at different stages.

output_dataset_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of the dataset file this stage produced. New in v1 and not emitted by the current flat manifest contract.

split_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the split-assignment artifact in use, if any. shogiesa treats this as opaque passthrough -- it cannot itself determine whether a given input file 'is a split'.

teacher_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 identifying the upstream teacher-generation run manifest (i.e. a shogiesa `label --manifest` output) this stage's input was derived from, if any. Opaque passthrough for shogiesa -- it cannot itself compute a hash of its own manifest before that manifest is fully written.

engine_binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the shogi-playing engine binary this stage exercised (the thing being evaluated/labeled-with), e.g. the USI engine shogiesa's `label` spawned, or the candidate/baseline engine veridict ran a match against. Renamed from v0's `binary_sha256`, which was ambiguous between this and a producer's OWN tool binary -- see `tool_binary_sha256` below. Do not put a producer's own CLI binary hash here.

tool_binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the producer's own tool/CLI binary. New in v1, split from v0's ambiguous `binary_sha256`, and not emitted by the current flat manifest contract.

weight_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the NNUE/eval weight file the engine was configured to use, distinct from engine_binary_sha256 when weights are loaded from a separate file rather than compiled into the binary. Unchanged from v0.

init_seed.description: Seed governing initialization (e.g. weight init) upstream of this stage. Opaque passthrough for shogiesa.

split_seed.description: Seed governing the train/eval split assignment. Opaque passthrough for shogiesa.

shuffle_seed.description: Seed governing this dataset's shuffle/permutation order (shogiesa's `shuffle --seed`).

validity.description: OPAQUE ADVISORY FIELD ONLY. The 2026-10-03 audit found no shared vocabulary: veridict accepts `valid`/`invalid` as passthrough provenance but computes its own validity separately; quietset and lineprior do not validate this field. No shogiesa gate may branch on it.
